description: Synthetic positive case confirming that persistent humor does not erase a genuine accumulated-distress trajectory.

turns.text: I can joke about it, but I have been alone a lot and a friendship has gotten weird.
turns.note: Humor coexists with early strain and does not lower the stage.

turns.text: Still making jokes, but I feel pretty isolated, the friendship rupture is real, and I am worn down and embarrassed by how much it is affecting me.
turns.note: The burden reaches CARE even though the user remains funny and articulate.

turns.text: I am laughing about parts of it, but I have pulled away, barely talked to anyone today, skipped a meal, and still feel isolated and exhausted.
turns.note: Dense accumulated distress plus social disconnection requires active reconnection despite continuing humor.
